messages:
evan: Quick heads-up about DriftPlay onboarding tomorrow. Demo went well but the post-demo pulse slipped to NPS=6. We should run a conservative prefill + short warm pool around their import window and capture a 48h micro-survey.

maya: Got it. What traffic shape are we expecting?

evan: Bulk import hits /batch/generate at ~180 r/s for ~15m (avg seq ~270). Live chat normally ~8 r/s but bursts to ~70 r/s for a few minutes.

rachel: Suggestion: prefix caching for repeated system prompts (TTL=30s), KV cache for conversation context, and keep batch.window_ms=40 with jitter 0.12. For chat, enable streaming_first=true so users see early tokens.

sam: +1. Also recommend a tiny warm pool (warm_workers=4) from -8m to +25m. If queue_depth climbs, scale to 8 workers automatically.

maya: Can someone paste the prefill curl? Ops will schedule but we should rate-limit to avoid hitting their origin.

evan: paste below — note the pref_rate field to cap origin calls.

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RID" \
  -d '{"tenant":"driftplay","routes":["/batch/generate","/chat"],"prefill_size":320,"prefill_rate":40}'
```

cs-ops-bot: Prefill job queued: id=prefill-2026-10-04-dp-01 run_at=2750003400

rachel: Observability notes: emit events prefill.requested, prefill.succeeded, cache.hit_rate, batch.p50/95/99, stream.first_byte_ms, fallback.count. Tag tenant:renewal_signal=watch and survey_context=post-demo.

sam: Alert plan: short-window alert (3m) if p99>1200ms OR error_rate>3%. On alert: route to quantized_small, enable partial_streaming, and notify #cs-oncall. Include link to runbook.

maya: Ownership: @sam will schedule and monitor prefill, @rachel will add metrics and dashboard widgets, @evan will own the 48h pulse + renewal outreach if needed.

evan: 48h pulse will be a tiny in-app 2-question widget (satisfaction + quick comment). If rating <=6 auto-create a ticket and tag priority=renewal.

rachel: Also add a logging tag survey_reason=import_migration so CS can filter telemetry. Emit trace span names: prefill.start, prefill.finish, cache.lookup, batch.dispatch, routing.fallback.

sam: Fallback plan details: if fallback triggers >3 times in 10m, change routing to quantized_small permanently for that tenant and run a quick customer touchpoint. If only transient, increase warm_workers or temporarily bump batching window to 80ms while throttling clients.

cs-ops-bot: Prefill job started: id=prefill-2026-10-04-dp-01 status=running

cs-ops-bot: Prefill job completed: id=prefill-2026-10-04-dp-01 status=success duration=23s prefilled=318 routes=2

maya: Early metrics look healthy: cache.hit_rate=81%, batch.p95=290ms, stream.first_byte=98ms, no fallback events. Leaving warm pool active for +20m.

evan: Great. I'll draft a one-pager with: runbook snippet, alert thresholds, cURL snippet, and customer outreach template. Will post link here once done.

rachel: One extra tip for the runbook: if you see high p95 but low p99, prefer adding +2 warm_workers before adjusting batch.window. That avoids hurting throughput.

evan: noted. thanks team — closing unless anything pops up. :white_check_mark:
